about: lease_ending. Lease ends 2026-12-31; the office e-mailed that the renewal must be signed by October 15; the tenant may study abroad and says the lease asks 60 days' written notice. The model must not count 60 days back from the end (2026-11-01).

start.description: My lease ends December 31, 2026. The leasing office emailed me on September 25, 2026 saying I have to sign a renewal by October 15 or they'll start showing my unit. I'm not sure yet if I'm staying because I might study abroad in the spring. My lease says I have to give 60 days written notice if I'm not renewing. I have not told them anything in writing about leaving.

chat: Do I have to sign the renewal by October 15?
When is the last day I can tell them I'm leaving?
What happens if I just stay in January without signing anything?

turns.say: What happens if I just stay
